key: SMOKE-2
summary: Add dark-mode toggle to settings page
labels: BradLight
status: Open
project: SMOKE
updated: 2026-05-26T00:00:00+00:00

When a user navigates to Settings → Appearance, a "Dark Mode" toggle is shown.
Toggling it switches the entire UI between light and dark themes immediately without a page reload.
The preference is persisted per user account and restored automatically on next login.
Only the logged-in user's own session is affected; other users' sessions are unaffected.
The toggle should be accessible (aria labels, keyboard navigable).
Out of scope: admin-level theme enforcement, per-page overrides.
Acceptance criteria are considered met when the toggle renders, persists across logout/login, and does not affect other users.
